<!-- pr-reviewer: 319a074ec28f7b98e9027c371f5afcca98ed8cc8 -->

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.**

## What looks good

- The Bore ring order is correct in isolation. `bore_started(p, Auto)` equals the old `bore(p)` move for move. `Outside` cuts the wall ring first and walks in. `Inside` is the centre-out order, because a bore has no inner wall. The motion pin proves each case.
- The value rides the undoable `EditOperationParams`, the generic MCP `edit_operation` door and the project key `pass_start`. `auto` stays off the wire and off the digest. The app pin covers the undo, the unknown-word refusal and the project round-trip.
- The new files have provenance lines and gate maps. The tests live with their code. The UI test updates the structural section list. No snapshot PNG, golden, `Cargo.toml` or `CHANGELOG.md` change.
- The fixing commit ends with `Fixes #3360`. The body has a `Changelog:` row.

## Blockers

1. **The PR is stacked on an old parent head, and it does not compile after the parent merges.** #3494 is stacked on #3353 commit `59b42c727`. #3353's current head is `a91eb11d3`, which adds two commits. That head removed `PassStart::rank` and replaced the ring law with `StartSide` and the note methods `wall_first_note`, `core_note`, `fallback_note` and `narrow_note`. #3494 calls the removed method at `crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore.rs:312`:
   `order.sort_by_key(|&k| pass_start.rank(...))`.
   The merge is textually clean, but the merged tree has no `rank`, so `cargo build -p camcraft-motion` fails with `error[E0599]: no method named 'rank' found for enum 'PassStart'`. To reproduce:
   ```
   git merge-tree --write-tree a91eb11d3 319a074ec          # tree 12c3e1a2..., no conflict
   git show 12c3e1a2:crates/motion/src/machining2d/pass_start.rs | grep 'fn rank'   # no output
   git show 12c3e1a2:crates/motion/src/machining2d/bore.rs | sed -n '312p'          # the rank call
   ```
   Fix: merge the parent's current head and rework `bore_started` onto the `StartSide` / level-curve law.

2. **The change clashes with the pass-start family warning law.** The family decision is commit `2ee7e0f8b` (#3402 WARN): a ring order that falls back must post a visible warning. The parent's current head makes the warning concrete with `StartSide`: `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pass_start.rs:69` (`wall_first_note`, a full-tool-width cut in uncut stock), `:101` (`fallback_note`) and `:111` (`narrow_note`). The Bore `Outside` order cuts the wall ring first, which is a full-tool-width cut in uncut stock. `bore_started` posts no warning, and `docs/decisions/3360-bore-pass-start.md:23` says the entry law does not change. The strict fallback clause does not bite, because a bore always honors all three orders; but the parent's full-width law does. The rework must either post the shared warning for the Bore full-width cut or state why the maintainer exempts Bore. Name this to the maintainer, because #3494 predates the law.

## Results

Built locally on this machine, in the review worktree at `origin/main` (`deb5364ee`) with #3494 trial-merged (`5ddfaad7`). The merge was clean.

- `camcraft-motion` `bore_pass_start`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
  - `bore_auto_keeps_the_centre_out_ladder_byte_for_byte`
  - `bore_outside_starts_each_level_on_the_wall_and_walks_in`
  - `bore_inside_is_the_centre_out_order`
- The app pin and the ui lib were not run locally. A cold app build (flecs) did not fit the time budget, and `sccache` stalled as the author's run did. The author reports: app `bore_pass_start` 3 pass, app suites pass, ui lib 1425 pass, clippy clean on the three crates. The blocker above is a static compile check on the parent's current head. It holds whatever the test results are.

## Not exercised

- Heavy lanes: the author did not run them, and no `#[ignore]`d heavy test exercises Bore.
- The full `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` plan is 752 steps, because the stacked parent's whole diff maps against `main`. I ran the touched binary directly.

## Notes (not blocking)

- The PR is a draft. #3353 is also a draft and must merge first. Then #3494 takes `git merge origin/main`, is gated again, and merges.
- The `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md` line in the combined diff comes from the parent commit `59b42c727`. The parent PR #3353 has `Process change: yes`. #3494's own commits change no process file.
- Files already over 400 lines grow a few lines: `generate.rs`, `params.rs`, `params_impl.rs`, `types/params.rs`. Not blocking.
- The project version stays 76, and `pass_start` is additive and defaulted. An older build that reads `pass_start: outside` ignores it and cuts Auto. For a bore the removed material is the same; the order differs.
- `docs/decisions/3360-bore-pass-start.md` has no "what it would cost to change later" section, which `docs/decisions/README.md` asks for.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
